title: SII Vol. 9 No. 46 — Peddavaduguru
location_detail: On A Stone By The Side Of The Isvara Temple At Peddavaduguru, Gooty Taluk, Anantapur District
summary: This is not dated; it belongs to the reign of the Chalukya king Satyasraya whose proper name appears to be Ereyitiyadigal

title: SII Vol. 9 No. 47
location_detail: On A Stone Lying To The North Of The Village Betapalli, Same Taluk And District
summary: This undated inscription belongs to the reign of the Chalukaya king VijayadityaSatyasraya

title: SII Vol. 9 No. 48 — Chippagiri
location_detail: On A Stone In The Bhogesvara Temple At Chippagiri, Alur Taluk, Bellary District
summary: This registers the grant of 50 mattars of land and a flower garden made by Bantarasa during the reign of the Chalukya king Vijayaditya-Satyastraya to DharmmaBhatara and some land to a temple with the consent of the Mahajanas

title: SII Vol. 9 No. 49 — Danavalapadu
location_detail: On Amultilated Slab Lying On The Bank Of The River Penneru At Danavalapadu, Jammalamadugu Taluk, Cuddapak District
summary: This damaged and updated inscription registers the grant of some fields made by the Chalukya king Vijayaditya to Bhupaditya

title: SII Vol. 9 No. 50 — A Mile To The North Of The Village Niluru
location_detail: On A Broken Pillar Set Up Before The Shrine Of A Linga, A Mile To The North Of The Village Niluru, Gooty Taluk, Anantapur District
village: A Mile To The North Of The Village Niluru
summary: This record in archaic characters is not dated and belongs to te reign of the Chalukya king [Ki]rttivarma-Satyasraya, probably the second king of that name

title: SII Vol. 9 No. 51 — On A Slab Set Up Near The Obalesvara Temple In The Village Kurukundi
location_detail: On A Slab Set Up Near The Obalesvara Temple In The Village Kurukundi, Alur Taluk, Bellary District
village: On A Slab Set Up Near The Obalesvara Temple In The Village Kurukundi
summary: This inscription of the reign of the Chalukya king Kirtivarma-Satyasraya registers the gift of some land

title: SII Vol. 9 No. 53 — Kurugodu
location_detail: On The Katte-Bande Rock North-East Of The Hanumanta Hill At Kurugodu, Bellary Taluk, Same District
summary: This record belongs to the reign of the Chalukya king Satyasraya whose proper name is not given, and specifies the land measure and the coin to be used at Kurumgodu
